columns.ID: source-defined grouping unit: herbarium voucher when applicable or field site for field-collected samples
columns.year_collected: collection year; used numerically in the released R model scripts
columns.mainland_island: source-defined origin factor with island for archipelago records and continent for mainland records; used in model 1
columns.galapagos_other: source-defined island factor separating Galapagos from other island systems; continental rows are missing; used in model 2
columns.island_group: source-defined island-system factor; continental rows are missing

unadjusted_filtered_mixed_model.pre_filter: drop missing petal_length and missing Bio_4; fit initial model; retain residuals strictly between -5 and +5; refit

bioclimate_mixed_model.formula: petal_length ~ mainland_island + year_collected + Bio_1 + Bio_4 + Bio_12 + Bio_15 + (1|ID)
bioclimate_mixed_model.pre_filter: drop missing petal_length and missing Bio_4; model machinery drops other incomplete covariates
bioclimate_mixed_model.reported_interpretation: about 9 percent smaller on islands after bioclimate adjustment

galapagos_vs_other_islands_bioclimate.formula: petal_length ~ galapagos_other + year_collected + Bio_1 + Bio_4 + Bio_12 + Bio_15 + (1|ID)
galapagos_vs_other_islands_bioclimate.reported_interpretation: Galapagos flowers approximately 50 percent shorter than other islands

izu_core_sensitivity_plan: reproduce source row, specimen-ID, island-system, and continental composition before modelling
retain the author mixed-model estimates as source-script anchors rather than silently replacing their modelling choices
average repeated flower rows within ID and fit specimen-level HC3 OLS as an independence sensitivity
fit specimen-level year plus Bio_1/Bio_4/Bio_12/Bio_15 adjustment
add continent fixed effects where estimable to reduce source-pool composition confounding
repeat the adjusted island-continent contrast after removing Galapagos to quantify leverage
report Galapagos versus other islands separately
never classify this dataset as an effective-dependency or specialist/generalist comparison
claim_boundary: Tribulus is one widespread lineage with repeated flower measurements nested within source-defined IDs. Island/continent contrasts may show within-lineage floral divergence but do not create independent island colonisation pairs, do not measure effective pollinator dependency, and do not identify pollinator or geological-origin causation.
